verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Pure regrouping. Lean keeps the whole Cauchy sum and divides once: ∂_RΠ_n = (Σ_{i+j=n} E_iE_j - Ω_{n-1})/R. The paper peels off the two endpoint terms i=0 and i=n as 2E_0E_n/R and leaves Σ_{i=1}^{n-1} E_iE_{n-i} inside the bracket. The identity between the two is PositiveAxisSystem.convolution_split (PositiveAxisSystem.lean:271), convolution n F = F 0 n + F n 0 + lowerConvolution n F with lowerConvolution n F = Σ_{i=0}^{n-2} F (i+1) (n-(i+1)); together with F 0 n = F n 0 = E_0E_n for the symmetric E·E product this is the paper's 2E_0E_n. The sign of Ω_{n-1} (subtracted) and the single power of 1/R agree. The Lean statement is a HasDerivAt for the primitive pressureHistory with zero axis datum, which is how the paper obtains Π_n by forward radial integration.
